reviewed_guards: 88 fixed diagnostic slots for 22 frozen cohort trajectories
invalid statistic reserved at p=1 is not a null pass
44 pointwise HAC intervals are explicitly not joint or primary RMSE intervals
five paired seeds are not used for unconditional R10 inference
no invented training predictions, PIT or V4 intervals
known exposure prevents a prospective claim
all months and methods are reported without outcome selection
mathematical_clarifications: For an optimal one-step conditional-mean forecast, errors are martingale differences even when volatility targets overlap. Overlapping targets are not an automatic explanation for rejected whiteness.
Classical Ljung-Box p-values are not heteroskedasticity robust and T55 is a limited asymptotic case; ARCH alone does not invalidate a point conditional mean.
Holm controls FWER only if individual null p-values are valid; applying it does not repair miscalibrated marginals.
